nodes.name: Magna Carta
nodes.label: Text
nodes.description: Charter of liberties issued in 1215; foundational legal text in the English constitutional tradition.

nodes.name: Domesday Book
nodes.label: Text
nodes.description: Survey and record of landholdings commissioned by William I; major administrative text of Norman England.

nodes.name: Act of Supremacy 1534
nodes.label: Text
nodes.description: Parliamentary statute declaring the monarch Supreme Head of the Church of England, severing ties with papal Rome.
